post.body:
Thinking About Attending Open Houses Alone? Here’s What You Need to Know.

Open houses are a great way to explore homes for sale in Fort Collins, Loveland, Eaton, and Wellington, but many buyers don’t realize that walking in unrepresented could cost them—big time.

Whether you’re a first-time homebuyer or an experienced buyer, having a real estate professional on your side is crucial. Here’s why:

1️⃣ The Agent at the Open House Works for the Seller—Not You

When you step into an open house, the listing agent is representing the seller, not you. Their job is to:
✅ Get the highest price possible for the seller
✅ Negotiate in the seller’s favor
✅ Protect the seller’s interests—not yours

Without your own representation, you could miss out on key negotiation points that could save you thousands.
